hypotheses.reasoning: At 10:16:57 ingest-api applied migration 0124_add_region_id to events-db. Step 1 renamed events.region_id to region_id_old. Step 2 then failed on a lock timeout. Because the DDL is non-transactional, step 1 stayed committed and was not rolled back. That left the schema half-migrated with no region_id column. From 10:18:33, events-db logs 'Unknown column region_id' / ER_BAD_FIELD_ERROR and ingest-api queries on events fail. ingest-gateway then returns 500 on POST /v1/events, which is what paged. Requests were succeeding just before the migration ran. The catalog-db disk-full errors explain the separate /search 500s, not this alert. The report-cron pandas error and the geo-IP connection reset are unrelated noise.
The migration may have shipped as part of an ingest-api release. Even so, the fault is the broken schema it left behind, which is data_integrity.
catalog-db ran out of disk. This affects search-api and web-bff /search, not ingest. It is a separate concurrent incident.

verdict.recommendedAction: Fix the events schema by hand. Either rename region_id_old back to region_id, or finish steps 2–3 of migration 0124 once the lock contention on events has cleared. Then confirm ingest-api queries succeed and the gateway 500s stop. Make future migrations transactional or idempotent and resumable. Separately, free disk on catalog-db (WAL growth) to fix the /search failures, and fix the missing pandas dependency in report-cron.
